scope: Static seven-family winner-selection contract for Tier2-eligible profiles. It records no selected champion and no simulation result. A winner may be written only after every Tier2-eligible current MWORKS route has a current-source ClimbPath 50 s minimum-closure record.

exclusions: official_pid is the fixed MWORKS A/B reference baseline and is not a PID-family winner candidate.
pid_awff_linear_eso is planned only and has no MWORKS model or minimum-closure record.
smc_boundary_layer remains Tier1 graphical-review evidence because its current model is a fixed-input probe without public reference or measurement ports.
nmpc_outer remains Tier1 graphical-review evidence because its current model is a fixed-input probe without public reference or measurement ports.
px4ctrl is the engineering/deployment baseline until a MWORKS-equivalent core passes explicit C++ behavior/interface equivalence.

official_pid.claim_boundary: The baseline is not a predeclared PID-family champion. Its current-source ClimbPath replay and later seven-scenario A/B records must use the same shared runner settings as each accepted family winner.

px4ctrl_core.claim_boundary: px4ctrl remains the later ROS1/Sunray/Gazebo/PX4/MAVROS deployment baseline. It enters formal MWORKS A/B only after a behavior- and interface-equivalent MWORKS core is implemented and validated.

selection_update_rule: Keep every winner_scheme_id null until all current-source Phase 1 records are terminal. For each semantic family, select the lowest valid position_rmse_m candidate, then apply the declared tie breakers. Do not use historical, pre-repair, neighboring-route, or different-profile results.
